# Subway Seat for iTerm2

ANSI colors plus cursor, cursor guide, selection, link, search match, underline, badge and tab color. Tab Color and Underline Color only show once their boxes are ticked in the profile.

[iTerm2](https://iterm2.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/iterm2/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in iTerm2 › Settings › Profiles › Colors › Color Presets… › Import…:

```sh
open "Subway Seat.itermcolors"   # imports the preset
# then Color Presets… › Subway Seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in iTerm2 › Settings › Profiles › Colors › Color Presets… › Import…:

```sh
open "Subway Seat Tunnel.itermcolors"   # imports the preset
# then Color Presets… › Subway Seat Tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in iTerm2 › Settings › Profiles › Colors › Color Presets… › Import…:

```sh

# then Color Presets… › Subway Seat Enamel
```

**London Moquette**, in iTerm2 › Settings › Profiles › Colors › Color Presets… › Import…:

```sh

# then Color Presets… › London Moquette
```

**London Deep Level**, in iTerm2 › Settings › Profiles › Colors › Color Presets… › Import…:

# then Color Presets… › London Deep Level
```

**London Portland**, in iTerm2 › Settings › Profiles › Colors › Color Presets… › Import…:

```

## Follow light and dark

In iTerm2 3.5+ › Settings › Profiles › Colors:

```sh
open "Subway Seat Light and Dark.itermcolors"   # imports the preset
# then Color Presets… › Subway Seat Light and Dark (choose Update Both Modes if asked)
```
